cells.claim: Pure provisioning and PAIR-layout logic is deterministic; depth contracts are added red-first
The built CLI and fragmented local HTTP boundaries cover bounded acquisition, timeout, truncation, response variants, stream cleanup, envelope parsing, and bounded QuickLZ decoding
Tracked Rust sources are formatted and warning-free
Pinned native Cargo resolution denies crates.io versions younger than seven days and the complete lockfile passes an independent age audit

cells.environment: Ubuntu 24.04 with pinned Rust mutation tool
cells.claim: Existing depth-stream, envelope, decoder, calibration, and ROS mapping mutation sets remain covered; the PAIR and RGB/JPEG decoders, RGB controls, RGB calibration parser, emitter fail-closed paths, stereo matcher/disparity encoder, spatial consensus/median filter, normalized global-shift diagnostic, map/Q parser/full reprojection, metric Z16/PGM, and robust depth-statistics focused sets catch all viable mutants exercised. The initial RGB set caught 40 mutants with two timeout-killed and two unviable, with none missed. The RGB calibration set caught 78 mutants with five unviable and none missed. The concurrent RGB-D transport set caught 14 mutants with one timeout-killed and one unviable, with none missed. Rectification, HTTP, and ROS runtime-adapter mutation gaps remain open

Real-hardware runs configured selector 1 PAIR output, enabled and settled the infrared projector, captured exactly 1048576 live bytes, disabled illumination, closed the stream, and restarted without power cycling

The Rust client recovered and QuickLZ-decompressed complete bounded envelopes; each 512000-byte frame splits into contiguous 640x400 left and right Y8 planes, and the emitted PGM images visibly contain the physical target

Selector 3 yielded a 1024000-byte Z16Y8Y8 frame: explicit 640x400 little-endian Z16 plus two Y8 planes. A live wall run had 64.0% nonzero depth, 167.8 mm median, 1.5 mm MAD, and 165.0-170.7 mm p10-p90 at the queried 0.1 mm scale

The bounded Rust path recovered a complete camera-50 RGB envelope, validated a baseline 1280x800 JPEG, separated its little-endian millisecond timestamp, and wrote a recognizable ordinary JPEG of the physical wall target
The Rust path downloaded and validated the live 1280x800 RGB intrinsics, five distortion coefficients, and the 3x3 plus translation left-depth-camera-to-RGB transform

The clean-room Rust command collected eight camera-21 depth and eight camera-50 RGB candidates, extracted both device-clock timestamps, selected the closest pair with RGB following depth inside a 50 ms bound, and wrote 640x400 depth and 1280x800 RGB images. A live run rejected a 171 ms startup-skewed first pair and then selected a 15 ms pair from the overlapping candidate windows

A live timestamp-paired capture projected 163174 valid depth samples into RGB using the public SDK transform convention. Stock CloudCompare loaded the binary little-endian colored PLY as one 163174-point cloud and computed normals

cells.environment: POP 3 Plus and a target with recognizable depth and color edges
cells.claim: Projection convention, timestamp pairing, JPEG decoding, color sampling, PLY serialization, and application interoperability pass. Pixel-level color alignment remains unqualified because the current wall target has no sufficiently distinct corresponding depth and color edges

cells.environment: Scanner disconnected after one live capture
cells.claim: The live command atomically published exact Z16, a viewable millimetre PGM, RGB JPEG, colored PLY, and a versioned calibration/timestamp manifest. Offline replay regenerated a byte-identical 163175-point PLY, which stock CloudCompare loaded and processed without the scanner

The archive validates session and sequence identity, commanded and optional observed angles, direction viewed from the axis tip, a near-unit axis, and a finite center in the depth-camera frame. Invalid and ambiguous values are rejected before capture

cells.environment: POP 3 Plus on tripod with a measured physical turntable
cells.claim: The capture contract and manual metadata command exist, but the physical turntable axis and center have not yet been measured in the depth-camera frame and no full rotation has been recorded

cells.environment: POP 3 Plus and measured physical targets
cells.claim: Scanner-computed depth now passes acquisition and layout checks, with a live 167.8 mm wall median and 1.5 mm MAD. Absolute accuracy remains unqualified because that target was only estimated at 150-300 mm rather than measured; clean-room PAIR reconstruction remains a separate diagnostic
Offline runtime message construction passes; live publication delivered 20 scanner-computed depth frames and a real subscriber observed a 640-wide 32FC1 image with matching CameraInfo publication

cells.command: ros2 run depth_image_proc point_cloud_xyz_node --ros-args -r image_rect:=/depth/image_rect -r camera_info:=/depth/camera_info
cells.claim: Stock depth_image_proc emitted a 640-wide organized PointCloud2 from scanner-computed depth and an independent ROS subscriber received it; visual geometry and measured-target accuracy are tracked separately

cells.environment: POP 3 Plus, turntable, ROS 2 Jazzy, RViz2
cells.claim: RViz2 launched with the supplied configuration and subscribed to the scanner-computed live cloud with a static optical-frame transform. Wayland denied automated screenshot capture, so direct-depth visual geometry and measured-target acceptance remain open
